checks.name: Only completed topics with actual native messages appear; grants, authored-only and minor topics stay excluded
Direct deep links and public selection cannot bypass report eligibility or expose starting technologies
Valid report selection retains exact native ID, model geometry, normal opening silence and deliberate replay audio
A missed completion event is recovered by a bounded live refresh without resetting query, scroll, model or audio
Burst completion events and concurrent refresh callers coalesce into one native list request
Fresh deep links query native report membership before selecting newly completed IDs
Immediate list errors retain current valid details and keep periodic retries bounded
A withdrawn selected report is covered and cleared before the native preview reset acknowledges
A stale native selection response cannot display a topic lacking its report message
A report withdrawn during native model layout never opens its transparent aperture
Closing or ending while a refresh is pending rejects late history and never reopens the preview aperture
Game-time rewind closes stale history; opening a lower-clock loaded save establishes a fresh baseline
Normal close retains the opaque cover until acknowledgement, and late layout cannot reopen a closed report
Major report notices preserve click/keyboard deep links; minor completion notices remain noninteractive
An authored definition without a current engine message cannot open through its completion notice
Generic notices and hidden/expired report notices cannot trigger report navigation
Missing artwork helper leaves the genuine report visible without substituting a lab icon
F5/Escape, menu preparation gates and dormant Duel retain their existing navigation boundaries

scope: Actual Intelligence/notices JavaScript in a bounded DOM and native-response fixture; native report eligibility remains authoritative. No browser, native engine, Android, model rendering or audio playback executed.
